data.text: I’m comfortable with that plan: I’ll take 12 tons if all five of us agree to the 12–12–12–12–0 split; otherwise, I’ll take 10. Keeping the lake replenished protects more than our next payday—it protects the village’s livelihood. Luke, thank you for offering to sit out this month; I support returning to 10 each next month. Jack, will you join us, and Luke, are you happy with this revised plan?
